get.description: Current user: filters/grouping select exact canonical populations; segmented exposures bypass the raw sketch. measure=exposures (default without segmentation) returns daily-rollup uniqCombined raw-identity exposure counts (~0.8% sketch error at scale); it differs from exact stitched users. measure=diagnostics uses exact canonical subjects and valid experiment/variant exposures, assigning each user once per experiment/requested bucket to earliest occurred_at,event_id. group.measure emits exposed_users, multiple_exposure (>1 observed variant), assigned_users and variant_share; per-variant shares sum to one when nonempty. Repeated exposures do not increase assignment. Zero users emit zero totals and no variant rows; missing/invalid names are excluded. All observed variants remain visible, including zero assignments. Day/week/month or whole range; hour rejected. First observed exposure is not an authoritative randomization log; contamination invalidates naive sample-ratio interpretation. Positive half-open range at most 366 days; at most 10000 complete points and bounded native work.

get.description: Every implemented metric requires a positive half-open from/to range of at most 366 days and returns a complete answer of at most 10000 points, or a permanent HTTP 400 problem asking the caller to narrow the query. Current user: filters/grouping are supported; event selection is rejected. Per-variant conversion for one experiment: exposed unique users, users with a conversion event at or after their first exposure (earlier conversions do not count), and the rate. Users exposed to multiple variants count in each. Counts and rates only; no significance testing.

get.description: Canonical user timelines ordered by millisecond occurred_at then event_id, with immutable duplicates removed. At most 20 ordered steps; one event cannot satisfy repeated steps. mode=sequential (default) allows intervening events; strict requires adjacency including automatic events, accepts current-user filters over complete participant timelines, and rejects event filters. Consider every start; select maximum reach, earliest completion, earliest start, then event IDs. window is inclusive seconds from first step, default range capped at 7776000. Repeat exclude up to 20 distinct validated names; exclusions between matched steps stop a chain, and cannot overlap steps. measure=count (default) emits cumulative reach. time_to_convert emits exact nearest-rank p50_seconds/p90_seconds for reached steps >=2, from the same selected chain. One/two group dimensions use the earliest eligible first-step event even when a later attempt wins; prop dimensions require only its schema; user dimensions use participant current traits. Sequential event filters select step rows and cannot hide exclusions. Positive half-open range at most 366 days; native execution/memory limits; at most 10000 complete points or HTTP 400. Per-variant timelines include only events at or after that user/variant first exposure inside the range. Multi-variant users remain in each variant.

get.description: Exact canonical daily activity with retained-history lookback; identity/profile-only events are excluded throughout. Day grain only. Filters and one/two group dimensions define the same population throughout lookback; each group is a separate population. Bot rows are excluded unless includeBots=true. Lifecycle emits nonnegative new, returning, resurrecting and dormant in group.status; first means first retained matching activity. Empty ungrouped days return zero measures.

get.description: Exact canonical retention over closed UTC days. mode=on (default) counts the exact offset day; on_or_after counts any day from offset through the largest requested offset, including unrequested intermediate days. cohort=window (default) means first matching activity in range; lifetime means first matching activity in retained history, not first ever. Date bounds select the observed activity interval and cohort dates. Offset 0 always emits cohort size. Omit immature on offsets; on_or_after omits nonzero offsets unless the full maximum horizon is closed by to. to cannot exceed the current UTC day. Day grain only; filters/grouping define identical populations throughout lookback. Bot rows are excluded unless includeBots=true. Up to two dimensions, eight bounded JSON filters, 32 distinct offsets 1..365, range at most 366 days and 10000 complete points.

get.description: Whole retained web sessions keyed by account/source_service/nonempty session_id; assemble before selecting the start date or UTC bucket. Defaults: measure=count, day grain, no grouping, includeBots=false. bounce_rate is exactly one page_view and no engagement divided by all selected sessions; lifecycle/identity/exposure events are not engagement. average_duration_seconds includes every selected session, including zero-duration visits, and measures last minus first observed event including page_leave. Attribute grouping/filters select first page_view, else earliest event; entry_page/exit_page come from page views. Arbitrary prop: filters/grouping are rejected. Any bot event excludes the whole session unless includeBots=true. Empty ungrouped buckets return zero; nonexistent groups are omitted. One/two dimensions, at most 8 AND filters (100 in values, 1024 UTF-8 bytes per string, 16384 decoded bytes), positive half-open range at most 366 days, at most 10000 complete points. Late arrivals and retained-history changes can change start/attribution/duration.
